#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

// Fast input
class InputReader {
public:
    InputReader() : pos(0), size(0) {
        is = stdin;
    }
    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isWhitespace(c)) c = read();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (!isWhitespace(c));
        return res * sign;
    }
private:
    FILE* is;
    static const int BUF_SIZE = 1024;
    unsigned char buf[BUF_SIZE];
    int pos, size;
    int read() {
        if (size == -1) throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
        if (pos >= size) {
            pos = 0;
            size = fread(buf, 1, BUF_SIZE, is);
            if (size <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buf[pos++];
    }
    static bool isWhitespace(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

// FFT functions
void fft(vector<double>& re, vector<double>& im, bool inverse) {
    int n = re.size();
    int shift = 32 - __builtin_ctz(n);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = __builtin_rev(i << shift);
        if (i < j) {
            swap(re[i], re[j]);
            swap(im[i], im[j]);
        }
    }
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int half = len >> 1;
        vector<double> cos(half), sin(half);
        for (int k = 0; k < half; k++) {
            double angle = 2 * M_PI * k / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
            cos[k] = cos(angle);
            sin[k] = sin(angle);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                double uR = re[i + j], uI = im[i + j];
                double vR = re[i + j + half] * cos[j] - im[i + j + half] * sin[j];
                double vI = re[i + j + half] * sin[j] + im[i + j + half] * cos[j];
                re[i + j] = uR + vR;
                im[i + j] = uI + vI;
                re[i + j + half] = uR - vR;
                im[i + j + half] = uI - vI;
            }
        }
    }
}

vector<int> polyMul(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b) {
    int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int n = max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(need - 1)));
    vector<double> ar(n, 0), ai(n, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
        int x = (a[i] % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        ar[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
        ai[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(ar, ai, false);
    vector<double> br(n, 0), bi(n, 0);
    if (&a == &b) {
        br = ar;
        bi = ai;
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
            int x = (b[i] % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
            br[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
            bi[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        fft(br, bi, false);
    }
    vector<double> fr(n, 0), fi(n, 0), gr(n, 0), gi(n, 0);
    double inv = 0.25 / n;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
        double a1r = ar[i] + ar[j], a1i = ai[i] - ai[j];
        double a2r = ai[i] + ai[j], a2i = ar[j] - ar[i];
        double b1r = (br[i] + br[j]) * inv, b1i = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * inv;
        double b2r = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * inv, b2i = (br[j] - br[i]) * inv;
        fr[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        fi[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        gr[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        gi[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }
    fft(fr, fi, true);
    fft(gr, gi, true);
    vector<int> ret(need);
    for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
        long long p = (long long)(fr[i] + 0.5);
        long long q = (long long)(gr[i] + 0.5);
        long long r = (long long)(fi[i] + 0.5);
        ret[i] = (int)((p + ((q % MOD) << 15) + ((r % MOD) << 30)) % MOD);
    }
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    InputReader in;
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int k = in.nextInt();
    vector<int> poly(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int d = in.nextInt();
        poly[d] = 1;
    }
    vector<int> res = {1};
    int exp = n / 2;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) res = polyMul(res, poly);
        exp >>= 1;
        if (exp > 0) poly = polyMul(poly, poly);
    }
    long long sum = 0;
    for (int x : res) sum = (sum + (long long)x * x) % MOD;
    cout << (int)sum << endl;
    return 0;
}
